title: LAMMPS-KOKKOS: Performance Portable Molecular Dynamics Across Exascale Architectures
problem: LAMMPS molecular dynamics code must adapt to modern heterogeneous computing with multi-vendor GPUs while maintaining performance portability
motivation: Enable LAMMPS to leverage exascale heterogeneous architectures efficiently across different force field models
method: Integration of Kokkos performance portability library into LAMMPS C++ codebase; implementation and optimization for pairwise, many-body reactive, and ML-based potentials
key_novelty: Production-grade integration of Kokkos into LAMMPS; demonstration of strong scaling across three exascale systems and Alps supercomputer with multiple force field types
contributions: Kokkos integration for performance portability across heterogeneous architectures
Implementation and optimization of multiple interatomic potential types
Strong scaling demonstration on OLCF Frontier, ALCF Aurora, NNSA El Capitan, and CSCS Alps
workloads: Force field calculations (pairwise, many-body reactive, ML-based)
limitations: Performance portability overhead likely exists but not explicitly quantified; specific performance metrics for scaling not detailed in abstract
primary_theme: Performance-portable molecular dynamics on exascale systems
